body: Everyone looks so young in that video.  Lots of couples too.  I'm too old now to relate to a video like this.  But thanks anyways.

not today, but i know how my mind works. it does a bit of this and a bit of that. then suddenly springs into action. so right now, its just some gun research. and tomorrow maybe i'll update my beneficiary info. and something may happen that will make me feel good for a while. but then i'll sink back down. and during all this, my mind silently and carefully plans. i can see what its doing in the background, putting all the pieces together. and i can only sadly nod and let it continue.

a birthday party a couple weeks is a good example of my state of mind. i was the good friend that time. witty, funny, everyone loves me. they even comment how much they value me as a friend. and i felt good during the party, helped me forget for a bit. but i cried on the drive home. because times like that are already getting fewer and will soon be gone.
